title: Serberus — Elevation Prompts
description: Presentation of the Serberus elevation prompt shown by the menu bar Sentinel. Delivered to the com.herojoneslabs.serberus.prompts preference domain.

justificationMinLength.title: Minimum justification length
justificationMinLength.description: Minimum characters for the reason when a rule requires justification (the rule's own requireJustification setting turns it on). 0 = the built-in minimum of 1, so any non-blank reason is accepted.

allowButtonLabel.title: Approve button label
allowButtonLabel.description: Text of the button that approves the request in the Sentinel's elevation prompt. Leave unset for the default, "Yes, continue".

denyButtonLabel.title: Deny button label
denyButtonLabel.description: Text of the button that declines the request in the Sentinel's elevation prompt. Leave unset for the default, "No, cancel".

brandTitle.title: Brand title (organization name)
brandTitle.description: Shown in the audit prompt's header next to the Sentinel icon (e.g. your company name). Empty = the default product name.

brandSubtitle.title: Brand subtitle
brandSubtitle.description: One line under the brand title (e.g. "IT Security"). Empty = no subtitle.

menuBarTopRulesCount.title: Menu bar — number of top rules
menuBarTopRulesCount.description: How many most-used rules the Serberus Sentinel menu-bar popover lists. 0 hides the section; the full rule list is always available in the Serberus window's My Rules tab.

auditRecipientLabel.title: Audit recipient label
auditRecipientLabel.description: The team name shown on the approval toast, which reads "event <id> · sent to <label>" (e.g. "Security", "Help Desk"). Empty or unset falls back to "IT".
